Priya: heads up — after we flipped the LB to http/2 + mTLS for idp endpoints, a customer reports SCIM provisioning from Azure failing with 400s, body says 'unsupported chunked encoding'. anyone seen this?
Sam: which tenant and request id? logs?
Priya: tenant acme-corp, req id 0a9f3c, pasting the curl we used and the error we see.
Priya: ```curl --http2 --cert client.pem:pass --key client.key -X POST "https://scim.redwood.example/api/Users" -H 'Content-Type: application/scim+json' --data-binary @payload.json``` -> 400
Priya: LB error: "upstream response: 400, client sent chunked body but server disabled chunked" (paraphrase)
Lia: that rings a bell — some app servers/frameworks expect HTTP/1.1 chunked semantics. HTTP/2 frames handle streaming differently so chunked flags can get lost.
Matt: @Priya can you confirm if the backend accepts h2? we proxy h2->upstream; upstream might be plain http/1.1.
Priya: backend is go-service listening http/1.1. nginx is configured to accept h2 at edge and proxy; we recently toggled proxy_http_version and chunked_transfer_encoding.
Sam: Azure AD's SCIM client will prefer http/2 when ALPN+mTLS present. It looks like its chunked-stream framing combined with our proxy caused the body to reach upstream as a chunked marker that upstream rejects.
Lia: short mitigation: force the scim route to use proxy_http_version 1.1 + proxy_request_buffering on so the proxy buffers full body and sends a normal request upstream. That avoids sending chunked markers upstream.
Priya: rolling a canary with buffering on for scim route (5% traffic).
deploy-bot: Deploy started for service scim-proxy v2026.03.12-canary at 1798004350
Sam: can you capture a raw tcpdump of the client->edge during canary? I want to confirm h2 frames and pseudo-header set.
Priya: small dump snippet: "HTTP/2 400" and pseudo-headers show ":method: POST", ":path: /api/Users", and no content-length header (body sent chunked).
Lia: if canary is clean, roll to 100% and then add a test to our CI to run a simulated azure-ad scim client over mTLS/h2. Also add a note to docs: prefer http/1.1 for SCIM upstreams unless the app explicitly supports h2 streaming semantics.
matt: opening ticket INF-8421 to add an integration harness + postmortem.
Priya: canary at 5%: success rate 98% over 10m, increasing to 100% now. final fix is proxy_request_buffering on + upstream http/1.1 fallback. will file the postmortem.
Sam: nice catch, thanks. :thumbsup:
Priya: thx all — logging follow-up in INF-8421 and adding rollout note in runbook.
